g.text: Review Product Goal / relevant milestone context
Confirm acceptance criteria and applicable Definition of Done
Break selected items into engineering tasks
for the Sprint Goal are performed.
Perform lifecycle work required by the Sprint Goal
Run relevant automated and manual verification
Run applicable quality and security checks
the Sprint Goal using Done work.
Selected work item satisfies acceptance criteria and applicable DoD?
Record completed work as part of the Sprint Increment
Return incomplete/discovered work to the Product Backlog for reassessment
- Sprint closes when its timebox ends.
- Incomplete work returns to the Product Backlog.
Record resulting decisions, discoveries, and backlog adaptations
